summary: Crescent Private Credit Income Corp., a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose routine monthly information: declared August 2026 distributions of $0.16500 per share for Class I and $0.16500 gross (net $0.14635 after fees) for Class S, payable September 30, 2026; reported NAV per share of $26.33 for both classes as of July 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of $553.7 million and debt/equity of 0.77x; and provided an update on its continuous registered offering of up to $3.0 billion. These are routine operational disclosures for a BDC, not a special situation. What to watch: monthly NAV and distribution stability.
